summary: Heal-first Doctor implant build. The clusters go, in order, to the two schools every heal requires (Biological Metamorphosis in all three grades - Head shiny, Chest bright, Waist faded - and Matter Metamorphosis wherever BM leaves a home free), to Treatment in two grades (Eye bright + Right Hand faded) because Treatment is cost factor 1.0 for a Doctor and gates every implant and symbiant QL it will ever wear, to Nano C. Init and Nano Pool and Max Nano Energy so the heal ladder can be chain-cast, to Time & Space because the 16-step TEAM HP buff line is the only Doctor line that requires it, to Psychological Modification for the UBT initiative-debuff line, to Matter Creation for the short HP buffs / heal-delta buffs / DoTs, and to Body Dev. and Stamina because the Doctor is the fight's aggro magnet and its own endgame armor is Stamina-gated. Pistol takes the one weapon slot that is genuinely cheap for a Doctor (cost 1.6) plus its cheapest special, Fling Shot (2.4). Every placement was validated against reference/implants.json by script: 39 placements, all legal for their slot and grade, no cluster used twice.
_gradeMeaning: shiny = biggest bonus, bright = ~60%, faded = ~40%. A skill placed in two implants (e.g. one bright + one faded) stacks. Because each cluster has exactly one shiny/bright/faded home across all 13 slots, some skills can only be obtained at a lower grade once their shiny home slot is spent on something else - and some get no cluster at all. See _coverageSummary and _deviations for which ones.
_qualityNote: QL values are the typical top-tier target for regular implants (~200). Higher QLs exist via Jobe/refined clusters and laddering; at endgame a Doctor replaces most slots with SUPPORT-unit symbiants (see doctor-symbiants.json). The QLs here are guidance, not values read from item data.

shiny.note: Head is the only shiny home of every nano school, and for a Doctor there is no argument about which one: BM (cost factor 1.0) is the primary cast requirement on EVERY heal, HoT, HP buff and complete heal, from Weak Team Heal (42408, BM 29) to Superior Team Health Plan (273312, BM 2153). This is the single most valuable implant a Doctor wears.

bright.note: Head is Nano Pool's bright home. Cost factor 1.0 and AOWiki's 'Always Max' - the nano bar is the Doctor's fight timer. Its shiny home (Chest) goes to Body Dev., so this is Nano Pool's best available grade.

faded.note: Thin Head-faded list (Trap Disarming / Vehicle Air / Perception / Sense / Tutoring). Sense is an ABILITY, so it helps meet the ability requirements on higher-QL implants and Support symbiants. Tutoring is cheaper for a Doctor (cost 1.0 vs an ability's IP) but does nothing in a fight.

build.notes: The core Doctor implant. Spending Head shiny on BM is what forces Matter Metamorphosis down to Left Arm faded and denies clusters to Treatment-shiny, Intelligence, Psychic, Pharma Tech, Sensory Improvement and Max Nano Energy shiny - see _deviations.

shiny.note: The Eye-shiny list (Aimed Shot / Vehicle Air / Electrical Engineering / Map Navigation / Rifle / Tutoring) contains nothing a healing Doctor uses. Electrical Engineering is cost 1.6 and is at least real work - it feeds the implant and armor tradeskill chains. Tutoring (1.0) is the cheapest filler if you want the IP back; Aimed Shot (3.2) only matters on an aimed-shot pistol build.

bright.note: Eye is Treatment's bright home, and with Head shiny spent on BM this is where Treatment comes from. Cost factor 1.0 for a Doctor and it gates every implant and symbiant QL: Treatment required = trunc(4.7237*QL + 6.7673), so a QL200 implant needs ~947.

faded.note: Eye is MC's faded home and, with Head shiny on BM and Right Hand bright on Time & Space, MC's ONLY available home. MC gates the short HP buffs (Life Channeler 96247 needs MC 781), the heal-delta buffs (Continuous Reconstruction 222824 needs MC 619), Malpractice (275701, MC 1727) and the whole DoT kit. A pistol-focused Doctor can take Pistol here instead - see _deviations.

build.notes: Core caster slot. Eye bright is a very crowded list (Treatment, Nano C. Init, PM, SI, Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Pharma Tech, Nano Programming) and Treatment wins it for a Doctor because nothing else in that list gates gear.

shiny.note: The only Ear-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 2.4 for a Doctor and useless to one - pure filler, keep the QL low if you are short on Treatment.

bright.note: Weak Ear-bright list (Concealment 2.4 / Vehicle Air 2.4 / Psychology 2.3 / Tutoring 1.0). Psychology is picked over the cheaper Tutoring because Alien/Combined armor assembly is Psychology-gated and a Doctor's endgame set (Combined Paramedic's) is built, not dropped.

faded.note: Ear is PM's faded home and, with Head shiny on BM and Eye bright on Treatment, PM's only available home. PM is the other half of the initiative-debuff line - Uncontrollable Body Tremors (99577) needs BM 861 AND PM 861, and AOWiki says to keep maxing PM 'even after you can cast UBT'.

build.notes: Taken almost entirely for the faded PM cluster; shiny and bright are the least-bad options in two near-empty lists.

shiny.note: Right Arm shiny is the weapon-and-special slot (1h Blunt / 1h Edged / 2h Blunt / 2h Edged / Assault Rifle / Bow / Break & Entry / Burst / Fling Shot / Full Auto / Grenade / Piercing / Shotgun / Strength / MG-SMG / Heavy Weapons). Pistol is NOT in this list - its shiny home is Right Wrist - so the best pistol-relevant cluster here is Fling Shot, the cheapest pistol special for a Doctor (cost 2.4 vs Burst 3.0, Aimed Shot 3.2, Full Auto 4.0) and the one present on nearly every pistol in items.ocp. Strength is the alternative if you do not auto-attack at all.

bright.note: Right Arm bright is Brawling (2.8) / Chemical AC / Physic. Init (2.0) / Swimming (2.0) - nothing a pistol Doctor uses. Physic. Init is the cheapest useful one and is real on a Martial Arts Doctor (MA is cost 2.0, the Doctor's second-cheapest weapon skill).

faded.note: Right Arm faded is Fast Attack / Mechanical Engineering / Parry / Radiation AC / Riposte. Mechanical Engineering (cost 2.0) at least feeds the armor and implant tradeskill chains; Radiation AC is the alternative if you want the armour instead.

build.notes: Low-priority slot for a healer. Only Right Arm shiny (Fling Shot) does anything, and only if you auto-attack.

shiny.note: Chest shiny is Body Dev. / Dimach / Energy AC / Max Health / Melee AC / Nano Pool / Sense / Stamina. Body Dev. (cost 2.0) wins over Nano Pool (1.0) because HP is the Doctor's ONLY mitigation - it has no reflect, no absorb and cost-3.2 close-combat evades - and healing is what generates the aggro in the first place. Nano Pool still gets its bright home in the Head.

bright.note: Chest is BM's bright home - the second of BM's three grades, stacking with the Head shiny. Nothing else in this list (Matter Metamorphosis / Projectile AC / Psychic) is worth more to a Doctor than more BM.

faded.note: Chest is Nano C. Init's faded home and, with Head shiny on BM and Eye bright on Treatment, its only available home. Cost factor 1.0 and AOWiki's 'always max' - cast and recharge speed on the heal ladder IS a Doctor's throughput. Sensory Improvement is the alternative here and loses its last cluster as a result - see _deviations.

build.notes: Core slot. Chest shiny/bright are the two biggest survivability-and-healing clusters a Doctor owns.

shiny.note: The only Left-Arm-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 2.8 for a Doctor and not a Doctor skill - pure filler.

bright.note: Left Arm bright is 2h Blunt / 2h Edged / Bow / Break & Entry / Piercing / Radiation AC / Strength. Strength is an ability, so it helps meet implant and symbiant ability requirements; every weapon skill in this list is 2.4-4.0 for a Doctor and unused.

faded.note: Left Arm is MM's faded home and MM's ONLY available home once BM has taken Head shiny and Chest bright - MM and BM share exactly those two homes. MM (cost 1.0) is the second requirement on every heal and HP buff; Improved Complete Healing (270747) needs MM 2153. This single faded cluster is the whole MM contribution from implants.

build.notes: Worn for the faded Matter Metamorphosis cluster. Shiny is dead weight.

shiny.note: Right Wrist is Pistol's shiny home. Pistol is cost factor 1.6 - the ONLY cheap weapon skill a Doctor has (Shotgun 2.4, MG/SMG 3.2, Rifle / Assault Rifle / Ranged Energy / Bow all 4.0) - and 17 of the 23 Doctor-locked weapon models in items.ocp are pistols. Ranged Init (3.2) is the alternative and is not worth it on a class whose real initiative is Nano C. Init.

bright.note: Right Wrist bright is 1h Blunt / 1h Edged / Aimed Shot / Burst / Full Auto / Multi Ranged / Nano AC / Rifle / Sneak Attack. Burst (3.0) is the only one of the three pistol specials observed in the data (Fling Shot / Burst / Aimed Shot / Full Auto) whose remaining home is here - Fling Shot took Right Arm shiny, Aimed Shot is 3.2 and Full Auto 4.0.

faded.note: Right Wrist is Fling Shot's faded home - the second Fling Shot grade, stacking with the Right Arm shiny. (Fling Shot's bright home, Right Hand, goes to Time & Space.)

build.notes: The weapon slot. On a Doctor that never auto-attacks, this whole slot is filler and the QL can drop.

shiny.note: Waist shiny is only the four elemental ACs (Chemical / Cold / Fire / Radiation). Pick whichever resist the content you run demands; Cold is a neutral default.

bright.note: Waist is Max Nano Energy's bright home and, with Head shiny on BM and Chest faded on Nano C. Init, its only available home. A bigger nano bar is more heals before you have to sit. Body Dev. is the alternative here (its bright home is also Waist) - taking it would give Body Dev. all three grades but cost the Doctor its only Max Nano Energy cluster.

faded.note: Waist is BM's faded home - the THIRD BM grade. Head shiny + Chest bright + Waist faded means every one of BM's three homes is spent on BM. No other cluster a Doctor can reach returns more.

build.notes: Core slot, and the third leg of the all-three-grades BM stack.

shiny.note: Left Wrist shiny is Multi Ranged or Multi Melee only. Multi Ranged (cost 4.0) matters solely if you dual-wield pistols; otherwise this is filler.

bright.note: Left Wrist bright is Attack Speed / Melee Energy / Parry / Riposte - nothing a Doctor trains. (Note: reference/implants.json flags 'Attack Speed' as an unverified cluster-to-stat mapping.)

faded.note: Left Wrist faded is Nano AC or Rifle only. Rifle is cost 4.0 and unused; 'Nano AC' has no confirmed base stat in Stat.cs (reference/implants.json flags it). Pure filler either way.

build.notes: The emptiest slot in the game for a Doctor - no caster, heal or Pistol cluster exists here at any grade. Lowest priority; a low-QL implant is fine.

shiny.note: Right Hand shiny is Trap Disarming (2.4) / Martial Arts (2.0) / Weapon Smithing (1.5). Weapon Smithing is the Doctor's cheapest of the three and feeds tradeskills. A Martial Arts Doctor takes Martial Arts here instead - that is the one build where this slot's shiny is a real weapon cluster.

bright.note: Right Hand is Time & Space's bright home and, with Head shiny on BM and Eye faded on Matter Creation, its ONLY available home. This is a Doctor-specific finding from the local data: the 16-step TEAM HP buff line is the only Doctor line carrying a SpaceTime cast requirement (Superior Omni-Med Enhancement 95709 = BM 852 / MM 769 / SpaceTime 769), and the top team HoT (269455) needs SpaceTime 810. Without this cluster a Doctor has no Time & Space from implants at all. Pistol and First Aid are the alternatives in this list - see _deviations.

faded.note: Right Hand is Treatment's faded home - the second Treatment grade, stacking with the Eye bright. Treatment is cost 1.0 and gates every implant/symbiant QL, so two grades of it is worth more than Computer Literacy or Nano Programming (the other realistic picks in this list).

build.notes: Core slot. Right Hand bright is the single most contested cluster in a Doctor build - Time & Space, Matter Creation, Pistol and First Aid all live here.

shiny.note: Legs shiny is Agility / Adventuring / Dodge-Rng / Duck-Exp / Projectile AC / Swimming. Dodge-Rng and Duck-Exp are tied as the Doctor's cheapest evades (2.4 each; Evade-ClsC is 3.2). Dodge-Rng is taken because its bright home (Feet) is also free, so it can be stacked in two grades. Agility is the alternative if you need the ability for symbiant requirements.

bright.note: Legs bright is Melee Init / Energy AC / Evade-ClsC / Poison AC / Stamina. STAMINA, not Evade-ClsC - and this is a genuinely Doctor-specific call read from the client data: Ofab Doctor QL300 requires Stamina 1099 and Chosen/Faithful Doctor QL300 requires Stamina 1099, so Stamina is what lets a Doctor wear its own endgame armor. Evade-ClsC is cost 3.2 and unbuffable by anything in the Doctor's kit.

faded.note: Legs is Body Dev.'s faded home - the second Body Dev. grade, stacking with the Chest shiny.

shiny.note: The only Left-Hand-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 2.4 and a melee special a pistol Doctor never uses - filler.

bright.note: Left Hand bright is Trap Disarming or Fire AC. Fire AC for a small armour gain; Trap Disarming is 2.4 and useless.

faded.note: Left Hand is First Aid's faded home and, with Head shiny on BM and Right Hand bright on Time & Space, its only available home. First Aid is cost 1.0 for a Doctor and gates the QL of the stims that cover you while a heal is recharging.

build.notes: Worn for the faded First Aid cluster.

shiny.note: Feet is Evade-ClsC's shiny home and - with Legs bright spent on Stamina and Waist faded on BM - Evade-ClsC's only cluster in this build. Cost 3.2, the Doctor's worst defensive skill, but the shiny grade is still worth having for free.

bright.note: Feet is Dodge-Rng's bright home; stacks with the Legs shiny for two grades of the Doctor's cheapest evade.

faded.note: Duck-Exp faded is the ONLY Feet-faded cluster in the game, and with Legs shiny on Dodge-Rng and Waist bright on Max Nano Energy it is Duck-Exp's only cluster here.

build.notes: The evade slot - gives all three evades at least one grade each.

_coverageSummary.BiologicalMetamorphosis: Head shiny + Chest bright + Waist faded - ALL THREE grades. The defining decision of the build.
_coverageSummary.MatterMetamorphosis: Left Arm faded ONLY. MM shares Head shiny and Chest bright with BM, so BM taking both leaves MM one cluster. See _deviations.
_coverageSummary.Treatment: Eye bright + Right Hand faded (shiny home Head spent on BM).
_coverageSummary.NanoCInit: Chest faded only (shiny home Head on BM, bright home Eye on Treatment).
_coverageSummary.NanoPool: Head bright only (shiny home Chest spent on Body Dev., faded home Waist on BM).
_coverageSummary.MaxNanoEnergy: Waist bright only (shiny home Head on BM, faded home Chest on Nano C. Init).
_coverageSummary.TimeAndSpace: Right Hand bright only - the team HP buff line's requirement.
_coverageSummary.MatterCreation: Eye faded only (shiny home Head on BM, bright home Right Hand on Time & Space).
_coverageSummary.PsychologicalModification: Ear faded only - the UBT line's requirement.
_coverageSummary.BodyDev: Chest shiny + Legs faded (bright home Waist spent on Max Nano Energy).
_coverageSummary.Stamina: Legs bright - taken as a gear requirement, not as a stat.
_coverageSummary.Strength: Left Arm bright. Sense: Head faded.
_coverageSummary.Evades: Evade-ClsC (Feet shiny only), Dodge-Rng (Legs shiny + Feet bright), Duck-Exp (Feet faded only).
_coverageSummary.Pistol and specials: Pistol (Right Wrist shiny), Fling Shot (Right Arm shiny + Right Wrist faded), Burst (Right Wrist bright).
_coverageSummary.Tradeskills: Electrical Engineering (Eye shiny), Psychology (Ear bright), Mechanical Engineering (Right Arm faded), Weapon Smithing (Right Hand shiny).
_coverageSummary.NOT IMPLANTED AT ANY GRADE: Sensory Improvement, Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Psychic, Pharma Tech, Nano Programming, Max Health, Nano Resist (no cluster exists for Nano Resist at all). Every one of these is explained in _deviations.

ladder: Max Treatment every level - for a Doctor it is cost factor 1.0, so there is no excuse. Equip requirement per implant QL: Treatment = trunc(4.723717064*QL + 6.767295257) (~QL*4.7+11, so a QL200 implant needs ~947 Treatment) and the governing ability = QL*2+4 (~404 at QL200). To reach a QL your raw skills do not allow, ladder: equip the low-priority slots (Left Wrist, Left Hand, Ear, Right Arm) first at whatever QL you can, stack Treatment and ability buffs, then swap the core caster implants (Head, Eye, Chest, Waist, Right Hand) in one QL step at a time. A Doctor has an unusual advantage here - it buffs its OWN Treatment: Superior First Aid (28675) gives +80 First Aid and +80 Treatment, Specialist Treatment (28674) +35/+20, Enhanced First Aid (28657) +10/+15, and the Nano Surgeon perk line adds +60 Treatment and +45 First Aid at max while Assault Force Medic adds another +40/+25. On top of that, stack a Trader wrangle, an MP's Composite Mochams (+140 all nano skills), an Enforcer's Essence and a Composite Attribute Boost for the ability side. Use Auno Implant Designer / TinkerPlants / AOLadderer to solve the exact sequence for your character. At endgame most of these slots are replaced by SUPPORT-unit symbiants - see doctor-symbiants.json.
_validation: Script-checked against AOBuddy/GameData/profiles/reference/implants.json: all 39 placements (13 slots x 3 grades) appear in their slot's list for their grade, and no cluster is used more than once anywhere in the build. Ability clusters (Sense, Strength, Stamina) and AC clusters (Cold AC, Fire AC) were checked the same way.
_deviations: Head shiny = BIOLOGICAL METAMORPHOSIS, not Matter Creation. Both the MP and the Soldier builds spend Head shiny on Matter Creation. For a Doctor, BM is the primary cast requirement on all 138 heal/HP-buff nanos in the local extraction and MC is a secondary school - so BM takes Head shiny, Chest bright AND Waist faded (all three of its homes), which is the largest single-skill commitment in any of the three class implant files.

Matter Metamorphosis gets exactly ONE cluster (Left Arm faded), and that is unavoidable, not an oversight. MM's three homes are Head shiny, Chest bright and Left Arm faded - and BM's three homes are Head shiny, Chest bright and Waist faded. The two skills a Doctor needs most overlap on two of three homes. Since every heal requires BOTH, and BM's requirement is always the higher of the two (e.g. Superior Omni-Med Enhancement 95709: BM 852 vs MM 769), BM wins both contested homes and MM takes the leftover. A Doctor makes the MM shortfall up with symbiants, Ofab/Chosen helmet (+24 MM at QL300) and Mocham's Gift: MatMet from an MP.

Sensory Improvement gets NO cluster. Its three homes are Head shiny (BM), Eye bright (Treatment) and Chest faded (Nano C. Init). SI gates Epsilon Purge (28659, SI 696), Superior First Aid (28675, SI 517) and Improved Instinctive Control (222856, SI 1033) - all out-of-combat buffs that can be cast with borrowed nano skill, which is why it loses the contest to Nano C. Init. VARIANT: set Chest faded = Sensory Improvement if you want those self-cast without a buffer; you lose Nano C. Init entirely (its other two homes are already spent).

Computer Literacy gets NO cluster even though AOWiki says 'always max' it. Its homes are Head shiny (BM), Eye bright (Treatment) and Right Hand faded (Treatment) - all three are spent on the two schools that gate healing and gear. Computer Literacy has to come from armor instead, and it does: Ofab Doctor Pants give +20 to +24 at QL300 and Chosen Doctor Pants +20.

Intelligence, Psychic and Pharma Tech get NO cluster for the same reason - all three live only in Head shiny / Eye bright / Ear faded, which are BM, Treatment and PM. Psychic is the awkward one because Ofab Doctor QL300 requires Psychic 854 and Chosen/Faithful Doctor QL300 requires Psychic 899; that has to come from symbiants, the Chosen Doctor Life Support (+20 Psychic at QL300), the Genius perk line (+40) and buffs.

Legs bright = STAMINA, not Evade-ClsC. Both the MP and Soldier builds take Evade-ClsC there. This build takes Stamina because the Doctor's own endgame armor is Stamina-gated at 1099 (Ofab Doctor QL300 and Chosen/Faithful Doctor QL300, read from items.ocp) and because Evade-ClsC is cost factor 3.2 for a Doctor - its single worst defensive skill - versus 1.6 for an MP. Evade-ClsC still gets its Feet shiny.

Right Hand bright = TIME & SPACE, which neither the MP nor the Soldier build takes anywhere. The reason is a local-data finding specific to this class: the Doctor's 16 TEAM HP buffs are the only line in its 240-nano kit that carries a SpaceTime cast requirement (BM+MM+SpaceTime), while the 38 team HEALS carry only BM+MM. Team HP buffs are a large part of what a team wants from a Doctor, so Time & Space earns the slot over Pistol, First Aid and Matter Creation.

Chest shiny = Body Dev. over Nano Pool, the same call the MP build made, but for the opposite reason. The MP is behind its pets; the Doctor is the thing the mob switches to when the heals land. Nano Pool (cost 1.0) is cheaper than Body Dev. (2.0) for a Doctor, so it is the more IP-efficient stat - it loses anyway because HP is the only mitigation a Doctor owns.

Waist bright = Max Nano Energy over Body Dev., the opposite of the Soldier build (which put Body Dev. in all three grades). A Soldier's nanos are long-duration pre-fight buffs; a Doctor's are the entire fight, so the nano bar is worth more than the third Body Dev. grade.

The weapon slots are real but cheap. The MP file writes Right Arm, both Wrists and Right Hand off as 'no caster clusters available; lowest priority'. For a Doctor, Right Wrist shiny (Pistol, cost 1.6), Right Arm shiny (Fling Shot, 2.4) and Right Wrist faded (Fling Shot) are genuine picks because Pistol is the one weapon skill a Doctor can afford - but unlike the Soldier build, they are not the point of the build and their QL can drop first when laddering.

PISTOL-FIRST VARIANT: if you actually intend to shoot, swap Right Hand bright from Time & Space to Pistol and Eye faded from Matter Creation to Pistol. That gives Pistol all three grades (Right Wrist shiny + Right Hand bright + Eye faded) at the cost of the Doctor's only Time & Space and only Matter Creation clusters - i.e. you give up the team HP buff line's headroom and the short HP buff / heal-delta / DoT headroom. Do this only on a PvP or low-level twink Doctor.

MARTIAL ARTS VARIANT: Right Hand shiny = Martial Arts (cost 2.0) and Feet bright = Martial Arts is not possible (one cluster, one home each), so MA gets Right Hand shiny + Left Hand faded (displacing First Aid). Right Arm shiny reverts to Strength and Right Wrist becomes pure filler. MA is the Doctor's second-cheapest weapon skill and the Kung-Fu Master perk (+50) supports it.
_unverified: The ~QL200 target for the core slots is the conventional top-tier regular-implant figure, not a value read from item data. No Doctor-specific published implant sheet was located (auno.org saved builds and aoitems.com are blocked to automation per the playbook), so this layout is derived from reference/implants.json plus the Doctor's own cost factors and cast requirements rather than copied from a guide.

The two 'alternative' picks named in several slots (e.g. Agility instead of Dodge-Rng at Legs shiny, Radiation AC instead of Mechanical Engineering at Right Arm faded) are stated as legal options, not as tested builds.

reference/implants.json itself flags three cluster-to-stat mappings as unverified and used in this build: 'Attack Speed' (Left Wrist bright), 'Nano AC' (no base stat exists in Stat.cs - avoided, Rifle taken instead at Left Wrist faded), and 'Time & Space' (sourceName MaterialLocation). The Time & Space mapping is load-bearing here; it matches the SpaceTime stat used in the Doctor nano cast requirements, but the cluster-name-to-stat join was not independently re-verified against client data.
Which elemental AC to put in Waist shiny is content-dependent and unsourced; Cold AC is an arbitrary neutral default.

The claim that Alien/Combined armor assembly is Psychology-gated (the reason Ear bright takes Psychology over the cheaper Tutoring) comes from general AO tradeskill knowledge, not from a page fetched in this pass. If that is wrong, Tutoring (cost 1.0) is the better filler.

Symbiant-versus-implant crossover: at endgame a Doctor replaces most of these slots with SUPPORT-unit symbiants, and exactly which slots stay as implants depends on the symbiants owned. That tradeoff is noted qualitatively here and modelled properly in doctor-symbiants.json.
